# Saabai

> Saabai (ABN 71 889 082 572) is a Gold Coast, Queensland business (head office Merrimac QLD 4226, Australia) founded by Shane Goldberg. Saabai offers website builds with care plans for small businesses, the Saabai Blueprint AI audit, and Lex, an AI legal research tool for Australian law firms. All prices are in AUD. Saabai is not GST registered (GST not applicable).

## Products

- [Website care plans](https://www.saabai.ai/websites): Saabai builds, hosts and manages small business websites with an AI enquiry chatbot built in. Care plans: Presence $100/month, Growth $200/month, Signature $300/month.
- [Saabai Blueprint AI audit](https://www.saabai.ai/blueprint): a ranked AI plan showing where AI saves hours and dollars. Starter $497 (48 hours), Pro $1,497 (3 business days, reviewed by Shane, 30 min walkthrough), Business $3,500 (2 to 3 weeks, team discovery, 12 month roadmap). Fee credited if you build with Saabai within 30 days.
- [Free AI Readiness Score](https://www.saabai.ai/score): a free 3 minute, 12 question quiz with an instant score out of 100 and three quick wins.
- Website builds: Presence from $2,000 build then $100/month care; Growth from $4,000 then $200/month; Signature from $6,500 then $300/month. The price only goes above the 'from' figure for custom integrations or other additional work, quoted in writing before work starts.
- [Lex](https://www.saabai.ai/legal): AI legal research and drafting for Australian law firms. Searches AustLII, ATO rulings and Australian legislation; every answer cites its source. Firm plan $299/month AUD; Enterprise custom.

## Case studies

- [Case studies](https://www.saabai.ai/case-studies): Tributum Law (Adelaide, South Australia ATO dispute and tax law firm, uses Lex for legal research) and [PlasticOnline (Holland Plastics)](https://www.saabai.ai/case-studies/rex-plastics-online) (Rex, AI quoting agent).

## Service areas

- [Gold Coast](https://www.saabai.ai/gold-coast), [Brisbane](https://www.saabai.ai/brisbane), Queensland and Australia-wide online.

## Terms

- Refunds: If work on a service has not begun, we will refund you in full on request. Once work has begun, we do not give change-of-mind refunds. Our services come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law.
- Saabai Blueprint credit: if you book a build within 30 days of your Blueprint being delivered, the full Blueprint fee is taken off that build. Credit applies to implementation costs only, not care plans or monthly fees. Any unused credit expires after 30 days.
- Full terms: https://www.saabai.ai/terms
